name: merge-duplicate-contacts
notion_automation: WIRED 2026-07-28. Notion DB automation on Contacts ("Duplicate of" edited) POSTs to trigger.webhook_url. The payload carries ONLY the page id — zero properties — so the workflow reads `Duplicate of` from a fresh page read; anything trusting the payload would conclude the relation is empty and silently do nothing. Notion does not expose automations via API, so re-wiring after any change to the catch URL is a manual step in the Notion UI.
description: Notion Contacts: Duplicate of set by a person -> merge the source into the target unless the two carry different LinkedIn profiles (since 2026-10-21 the person's call stands otherwise; the Jev name-mismatch check was removed). Fills empty target fields, ORs checkboxes, UNIONS every multi-value property, never copies the Duplicate of / Possible duplicate relations, comments on the source with what was copied, then moves it to the Notion trash (never a permanent delete) unless it has page content or is older than the target, in which case it is left in place.
is_private_note: Corrected 2026-10-03: get-workflow reports is_private false, so this Zap is account-visible. The previous `true` here (and CLAUDE.md listing it as a grandfathered private Zap) were wrong.
